_doc: World events (systems/events.gd), cleaning streak, the Requests board (contracts and world events, systems/contracts.gd) with its reward track (fleet liveries, Builder parts, capsules; it replaced the token shop) and the Collection (trinkets: collectibles, not a currency) [money]. Times are seconds of play. Event rewards scale with progress: cubes = max(min_cubes, income_rate * income_s, lifetime_earned * earned_frac), so they stay a spike (about a minute or two of income) at every stage. schedule.every_s is the gap between the end of one event and the start of the next; events only start once min_hexes hexes have been cleaned (lifetime) and never in the middle of a menu, cinematic or rocket flight.

events.name: Supply Drop
events.toast: Supply Drop! A crate parachuted onto the junk %s of you. Clear the junk around it to crack it open.
events.hud: Clear the junk around the crate

events.name: Salvage Surge
events.toast: Salvage Surge! A hex %s of you is glowing: its junk is worth 3x for two minutes.
events.hud: Junk from the glowing hex is worth 3x

events.name: Rain Shower
events.toast: Rain Shower. Real rain, the first in years. Your plants won't dry out while it lasts.
events.hud: Plants stay watered while it rains

events.name: Robot Hiccup
events.toast: %s has the hiccups and stopped working. Walk over and press E for a quick fix.
events.hud: Walk to the stuck robot and press E

events.name: Wildlife Visit
events.toast: Something is visiting a thriving hex %s of you. Sneak up and press E to take a photo.
events.hud: Find the visitor and press E for a photo

events.name: Rare Part Signal
events.toast: Rare Part Signal! The detector caught a strong ping %s of you. Follow the violet beam.
events.hud: Dig up the part under the violet beam

events.name: Ledger Audit
events.toast: Ledger Audit! A friendly drone bets it can clear a patch of junk %s of you faster than you. Race it!
events.hud: Scoop more of the ringed junk than the drone

streak._doc: Points = pieces scooped in a row (Patch scoops up to ~8 a second). After grace_s without a scoop the points drain at drain_per_s, so a bale or a short walk barely dents it and only a long break resets it. The bale bonus uses the best tier reached while that bale was being filled.

contracts._tiers: tier from lifetime hexes cleaned: below 12 = 0, below 40 = 1, below 100 = 2, else 3

templates.text_1: Get one more hex to Sustained

contracts._requests: [money] Requests board: contracts and world events are one board (workbench Requests tab). A request pays Cubes (income_s seconds of current income, WorldEvents.progress_cubes) or Parts (parts[tier]); there are no tokens. Every finished request and every handled world event counts toward the reward track: liveries, Builder parts, Curio Capsules and rare robot parts unlock at those counts (they used to be the token shop). After the last step, every repeat_every requests prints a Vintage robot part.

liveries.name: Neon Underglow
liveries.desc: A cyan glow ring under every robot in the fleet.

liveries.name: Sunset Underglow
liveries.desc: Warm orange underglow for the whole crew.

liveries.name: Crew Pennants
liveries.desc: Every robot flies a little Greenfall pennant.

liveries.name: Holo Halos
liveries.desc: A slowly turning hologram halo over each robot. Very smug.

trinkets.name: Brass Compass
trinkets.desc: Points north, mostly. Came wrapped in a sock in a supply crate.

trinkets.name: Wind-up Tin Robot
trinkets.desc: Walks three steps and falls over. Lumi relates.

trinkets.name: Seed Locket
trinkets.desc: A locket with one seed inside instead of a photo. Someone loved gardens.

trinkets.name: Snow Globe
trinkets.desc: A tiny city under glass, still clean. A promise, maybe.

trinkets.name: Cradle Crate Stencil
trinkets.desc: The stencil used to paint every supply crate. WREN asked for it back. You said no.

trinkets.name: Golden Bolt
trinkets.desc: Fell out of a surge hex, still warm. Fits nothing. Worth everything.

trinkets.name: Surge Glass
trinkets.desc: A sliver of glass that kept the surge's glow. It hums when you hold it.

trinkets.name: Jar of First Rain
trinkets.desc: Collected during the first rain in years. Do not drink. Do not open. Just look.

trinkets.name: Paper Boat
trinkets.desc: Someone made it from a coupon. It sailed a whole puddle.

trinkets.name: Lucky Spanner
trinkets.desc: Fixes any hiccup, if you hit the right spot. Usually the left side.

trinkets.name: Diagnostic Tape
trinkets.desc: A printout of a robot hiccuping. It looks a lot like a song.

trinkets.name: Photo: Glowtail Fox
trinkets.desc: Its tail glows when it's curious. It was very curious about Lumi.

trinkets.name: Photo: Moss Deer
trinkets.desc: Moss grows on its antlers. Butterflies rest there like it's a tree.

trinkets.name: Photo: Lantern Hedgehog
trinkets.desc: The tips of its spines glow amber at dusk. It ate a beetle on camera. Sorry.

trinkets.name: Photo: Prism Heron
trinkets.desc: Its feathers split light into rainbows. It stood on one leg the whole time.

trinkets.name: Photo: Velvet Hare
trinkets.desc: Soft as a whisper, quick as a rumour. The photo is a little blurry. Worth it.

trinkets.name: Photo: Stray Cat
trinkets.desc: A photo from photo mode. Old Town's cats never left.

trinkets.name: Photo: Pigeon
trinkets.desc: A photo from photo mode. Pigeons will live anywhere people once dropped crumbs.

trinkets.name: Photo: Sparrow
trinkets.desc: A photo from photo mode. Small, brown and bossy.

trinkets.name: Photo: Rat
trinkets.desc: A photo from photo mode. Rats live in the gaps between the piles.

trinkets.name: Photo: Rabbit
trinkets.desc: A photo from photo mode. Rabbits arrive as soon as there is something green to nibble.

trinkets.name: Photo: Roe Deer
trinkets.desc: A photo from photo mode. Shy grazers that keep to the edge of the green, where they can see what's coming.

trinkets.name: Photo: Red Fox
trinkets.desc: A photo from photo mode. A fox trots along the hedges, nose down, tail out.

trinkets.name: Photo: Honeybee
trinkets.desc: A photo from photo mode. Bees came back with the blooms.

trinkets.name: Photo: Robin
trinkets.desc: A photo from photo mode. When a hex thrives, robins move in and sing.

trinkets.name: Photo: Firefly
trinkets.desc: A photo from photo mode. Tiny green lanterns over the grass after dark.

trinkets.name: Photo: Lake Fish
trinkets.desc: A photo from photo mode. Once the water clears you can see them: small silver schools turning together over the sand.

trinkets.name: Photo: Mallard
trinkets.desc: A photo from photo mode. Ducks paddle, dabble with their tails in the air and complain loudly about everything.

trinkets.name: Photo: Green Frog
trinkets.desc: A photo from photo mode. Frogs sit at the water's edge and sing in the evening.

trinkets.name: Photo: Sand Lizard
trinkets.desc: A photo from photo mode. Lizards bask on swept ground between the solar arrays and vanish in a blink when a shadow falls on them.

trinkets.name: Photo: Fennec Fox
trinkets.desc: A photo from photo mode. A tiny desert fox with enormous ears.

trinkets.name: Photo: Harbour Seal
trinkets.desc: A photo from photo mode. Seals haul out on the quay once it's clean, lounge in heaps, and flop back to the water if you come too close.

trinkets.name: Photo: Herring Gull
trinkets.desc: A photo from photo mode. Loud, white and opportunistic.

trinkets.name: Photo: Arctic Fox
trinkets.desc: A photo from photo mode. White as the snow it hunts on.

trinkets.name: Photo: Grey Heron
trinkets.desc: A photo from photo mode. Herons stand perfectly still at the water's edge, then strike.

trinkets.name: Photo: Pond Turtle
trinkets.desc: A photo from photo mode. Turtles cruise the drowned streets with their heads up, as if they've always lived here.

trinkets.name: Photo: Cradle Crane
trinkets.desc: A photo from photo mode. White cranes circle high over the landing city on slow wingbeats.

trinkets.name: Maker's Badge
trinkets.desc: Pinned inside a Legendary part: 'Built to be fixed.'

trinkets.name: Signal Crystal
trinkets.desc: The thing that was pinging. It still pings, very quietly, when you're happy.

trinkets.name: APPROVED Stamp
trinkets.desc: The Ledger's rubber stamp. It now only says APPROVED. It's very proud of that.

trinkets.name: Race Propeller
trinkets.desc: A souvenir from the audit drone. It insists the race was close.

trinkets.name: Streak Medal
trinkets.desc: Earned for a max-tier cleaning streak. Scoop scoop scoop.

trinkets.name: Lumi's First Lens Cap
trinkets.desc: Lumi Level 10. The cap Lumi wore on the ark, scuffed and kept anyway.

trinkets.name: Seed-Keeper Pin
trinkets.desc: Lumi Level 20. A little enamel sprout. The ark gave these to its gardeners.

trinkets.name: Tread Charm
trinkets.desc: Lumi Level 30. A brass bell for the treads. It jingles on every bump.

trinkets.name: Pocket Star Chart
trinkets.desc: Lumi Level 40. The ark's route home, folded small. One star is circled.

trinkets.name: Glow Ribbon
trinkets.desc: Lumi Level 50. A ribbon that holds a little light. Lumi ties it to the antenna.

trinkets.name: Contract Pen
trinkets.desc: Your first contract signed. The pen has a tiny leaf on top.

trinkets.name: Foreman's Clipboard
trinkets.desc: Ten contracts done. Every box ticked, every box green.

trinkets.name: Contractor's Crown
trinkets.desc: Twenty-five contracts. The crown is a bent can. You wear it anyway.

trinkets.name: Rubber Frog
trinkets.desc: Squeaks in a minor key.

trinkets.name: Tiny Cactus
trinkets.desc: Needs no water. Mocks the Drips.

trinkets.name: Holo Koi
trinkets.desc: A hologram fish that swims round your hopper.

trinkets.name: Moon Rock
trinkets.desc: Not from the moon. From a parking lot. Still beautiful.

event_supply_drop: Crate inbound. From... me? I don't remember sending that. Open it.
Supply drop! I found an old Cradle pod still in orbit and nudged it down.
Another care package. I've been saving them for good days. This is one.
event_salvage_surge: That hex is glowing. Readings say... valuable. Hurry.
Surge! The old buried cables light up when the junk shifts. Grab it while it's bright.
Look at that glow. Three times the value, two minutes. Go go go.
event_rain_shower: Is that... water? From the sky?
Rain. I'd forgotten the sound. Your plants hadn't.
Rain on clean ground. It smells like a memory.
event_robot_hiccup: One of your helpers is stuck. Hic.
{robot} has the hiccups. Try a firm pat on the chassis.
event_wildlife_visit: Something alive is moving out there. Not a robot.
A visitor! Go slowly. Take a picture, it lasts longer.
The thriving hexes are calling things home. Look.
event_rare_part_signal: Strong signal. Something old and well made.
That ping is Maker-grade. Follow the violet light.
A rare part, close. I can almost hear it.
event_ledger_audit: The Ledger wants to race. I told it you'd win.
Audit drone, friendly. It's very competitive now.
The Ledger says it's 'just a routine audit'. It's been practising.
event_won: Well done. That's going in my log.
streak_max: Max streak. The scoop is singing.
contract_done: Contract complete. Collect at the workbench.
Another contract done. Tokens are waiting.
Contract fulfilled. The board's lit up green.
